name: Improved Symbiont Resilience
body:
You can coax additional protection out of your symbiont.

Prerequisite(s): Symbiont Resilience, Symbiont Handler

Benefit(s): The damage reduction you gain from Symbiont Resilience now lasts for 1 minute per Hit Die of your bonded symbiont, and this damage reduction may be activated as an immediate action. If you are bonded with more than one plant symbiont, you must choose which plant symbiont you gain the damage reduction from.

You must remain bonded with the plant symbiont while benefiting from its damage reduction.
